<thought>Based on the observed isotopic pattern—a dominant monoisotopic peak with a ~6.7% M+1 peak and progressively smaller M+2, M+3 peaks matching the expected distribution for multiple 13C atoms—we can definitively identify carbon as the element responsible for the pattern. No characteristic chlorine, bromine, or sulfur patterns are present, and other elements have isotopic contributions too small to be distinguished.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
